summary: The mobile hero clips the primary installation command. The desktop layout is readable overall, with a few awkward Japanese line breaks.

findings.description: [defect] At 390 px, the hero’s Homebrew command is cut off after `brew install kestrel-trace/tap/`, hiding the `kestrel` package name. Let the command wrap or give it a full-width row above the copy button.
[defect] The green status dot in the mobile hero badge sits alone above the label. Keep it aligned with the first line when the label wraps.

[defect] Several desktop text blocks leave awkward fragments on their last line. The hero paragraph ends with `す。` on its own line, the workflow heading leaves `で` alone, and the benchmark heading splits `テスト` across lines. Adjust the text widths or line breaks.
